source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Three county campgrounds added (Deep Creek at Green Lane Park, Montgomery County; Tohickon Valley and Lake Towhee, Bucks County - motorhomes to 25 ft) plus the Corps of Engineers' Woodcock Lake Park / Colonel Crawford Park, added as CLOSED per recreation.gov. Excluded: tent-only (Mauch Chunk Lake, Mill Creek), no trailers (Tinicum), residents-only (Alverthorpe), long-term (Snow Shoe), trail trekker site (Cedar Creek). About 200 private campgrounds and a few federal/utility ones are unmatched in OSM - outside this pass.

added.name: Woodcock Lake Park (Colonel Crawford Park Campground)

excluded.name: Snow Shoe Park
excluded.why: caters to long-term and full-time campers; only 2 transient pull-thrus

excluded.name: Mauch Chunk Lake Park (Carbon County)
excluded.why: county rate page lists tent, cottage and group camping only - no RV/trailer sites

excluded.name: Tinicum Park (Bucks County)
excluded.why: county rules: no travel homes or trailers at Tinicum Park

excluded.name: Mill Creek Camping Area (Lancaster County Central Park)
excluded.why: five primitive tent sites; county says RVs and pop-ups cannot be accommodated

excluded.name: Alverthorpe Park Campground (Abington Township)
excluded.why: park open to Abington residents and their guests only

excluded.name: Cedar Creek Trekker Campground (Westmoreland County)
excluded.why: trail trekker tent campground on the Youghiogheny River Trail

held.name: Colonel Crawford Park (Crawford County listing)
held.why: same campground as Woodcock Lake Park (USACE), added as one entry
